subject: Next steps: runtime choice & quickstart for inference endpoints
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@securify.com>; Tom Burns <tom.burns@securify.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: runtime choice & quickstart for inference endpoints

Thanks for the time today — appreciate the walkthrough of Securify's ingestion and classification flow. Quick recap from my side and three asks so we can map you to the right onramp (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

1) Quick recap
- Key endpoints you mentioned: classify (batch + realtime), summarize (async), and rerank (latency-sensitive).
- Current target: pilot for 6 weeks, then roll to 100k users.

2) Asks we need to size/provide a concrete quickstart:
- Traffic profile: peak RPS, typical concurrent requests, average tokens in/out, and burst characteristics (e.g., sustained vs spike). Please attach a simple matrix (per-endpoint).
- Data residency / VPC requirement: is PII in requests or would a hosted sandbox be acceptable for pilot?
- SLA/throughput targets: is sub‑200ms p95 for rerank a hard requirement?

3) Quickstart for Hosted API (what we can stand up quickly)
- Sandbox endpoints with isolated prefix and token keys (default rate slice: 10 rps, adjustable).
- Three-tier rate limits: trial (10 rps), pilot (50 rps), canary/production (custom / reserved capacity).
- KV/prefix caching recommendations for classify and summarize to reduce token spend.

If you can send the traffic matrix and confirm whether VPC is required for pilot, I’ll draft a one‑page quickstart plan and a suggested timeline (sandbox + warm-up + smoke tests). I attached a short template you can fill (securify_traffic_profile.xlsx).

Proposed next touch: short 30m call early next week to review the matrix and pick a pilot slice. My calendar: https://calendly.com/karthik-redwood/30

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: securify_traffic_profile.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@securify.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Burns <tom.burns@securify.com>, procurement@securify.com
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 18:30:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: runtime choice & quickstart for inference endpoints

Thanks, Karthik — useful recap. I added a few notes inline and attached a quick export of our estimated production traffic. Answers to the three asks below: 

- Traffic profile: peak ~20 RPS overall (with rerank spikes up to 35 RPS for short windows). Average request size ~120 tokens in / ~180 tokens out. I attached the CSV (Securify_prod_matrix.csv) with per-endpoint breakdown.
- Data residency / VPC: For pilot we can use hosted sandbox but anything that touches full customer PII must go over VPC. Pilot will use synthetic/anonymized data; production must be within our APAC region and have VPC option.
- SLA/throughput: Rerank ideal p95 < 200ms; classify and summarize can tolerate up to 600ms p95.

Decision makers: Tom (CTO) is the technical approver and will sign off on any Dedicated/Private sizing. Procurement (procurement@securify.com) handles contracts and needs a draft SOW if we move forward.

Next steps for us: please send the quickstart plan and example sandbox keys/rate slabs you mentioned. We can do the 30m call — available Mon 29th 08:00–11:00 AEST / Mon 29th 22:00–23:30 PDT.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Product Ops Lead, Securify Inc.
Attachment: Securify_prod_matrix.csv (CSV, 18KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@securify.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 02:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: runtime choice & quickstart for inference endpoints

Lisa — great, thanks for the matrix and the timing windows. Based on what you provided, here's a tailored quickstart recommendation for the pilot and decision criteria for switching to Dedicated/Private: 

Host recommendation (Pilot): Hosted API sandbox
- Rationale: pilot uses synthetic data and peaks ~20–35 RPS; sandbox with isolated keys and prefix caching minimizes setup time and cost.
- Provisioning: sandbox endpoints provisioned within APAC region; we can set initial trial slice to 15 rps and bump to 35 rps during scheduled smoke tests.

When to consider Dedicated
- Sustained production >50 RPS or consistent token volume that exceeds the hosted cost target.
- Required isolation beyond logical prefixes (e.g., dedicated GPU pool) or contractual SLA needing capacity guarantees.

When to consider Private (VPC/on‑prem)
- Any flow processing full customer PII in production or if your security team requires HSM/KMS keys under your control.

Quickstart deliverables (we'll send as a single packet):
- Sandbox endpoint keys and example curl calls + SDK snippet.
- Suggested rate-slabs: trial 15 rps (soft), pilot 35 rps (scheduled), canary/prod: recommended commit ranges.
- KV/prefix caching config for classify/summarize to reduce token spend by ~30% on average.
- Pilot runbook: warm-up, smoke tests for rerank p95, and roll-to-canary checklist.

Attachments: redwood_quickstart_playbook.pdf (short playbook, 6 pages). Also sharing a HubSpot reference for our pilot record: HS-678910. If that looks good I’ll prepare a 1‑page SOW draft for procurement and a link to a short DS (DocuSign) for the pilot agreement: https://redwood.ai/ds/DEAL-3491-pilot

Proposed meeting slot: Mon 29 Apr 2028, 08:30 AEST / Sun 28 Apr 22:30 PDT. I’ll calendar‑invite once you confirm which window works.

Thanks — looping in Aditya for pricing/commit guidance and Monica for onboarding ops.

— Karthik
Attachment: redwood_quickstart_playbook.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
